## Current objective: Fix refund double-counting in the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, using small, reviewable commits. The Tenacity refactor is superseded until next sprint. After the three shard-copy steps, continue the KMS document re-encryption procedure in order. For new Sentry issues, prefix titles with `[billing]` and fingerprint them as `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`. Sandbox payments use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is obsolete.

## Recent work: Currency-rounding tests were expanded and pass; the full suite passed (184 passed, 2 skipped), and Ruff passed. KMS shard verification confirmed all three 100 MiB copies use key ID `7f3a6d21-84c9-4b8e-9f12-6a0c3d5e8b41`; no destructive step has been run. In `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py`, `pending_events.pop()` was initially placed too early, then moved below `record_usage_event()` so persistence failures retain the event; the focused retry test passed. A temporary breakpoint in `process_batch()` showed pending events are 0 after the first batch and 3 after the second, indicating the current debug work is unresolved. The next priority is to inspect this behavior, remove the breakpoint, run the full worker tests, and then investigate reconciliation refund accounting.
